To assess the nutritive value of these two fatty acids in Chinese mitten crab (Eriocheir sinensis), we performed transcriptome analysis and label-free quantification proteomic analysis of the hepatopancreas from mitten crabs fed with LA or LNA diet.
A total of six crabs that had the average weight were selected for the use of the proteomic analysis with three crabs in each group
After acclimation, 48 active male crabs with intact appendages were selected and randomly stocked into 48 plastic boxes (36 cm × 18 cm × 18 cm).
the peptides in each group were divided into triplicate for the proteomic analysis to minimize equipment error
